name: Walschensaal
kurzbeschreibung: The mystical Walschensaal in the Tux Valley is a protected geological rock cavity and a peaceful sanctuary set within alpine forests.
beschreibung:
Overview

The enigmatic Walschensaal is a secluded natural landmark and protected natural monument nestled within the Tux Valley in the Zillertal Alps above Lanersbach and Tux. Local mountain farmers historically referred to Romance-speaking cattle drovers and merchants crossing the high alpine passes from the south as "Walschen". The Walschensaal is a fascinating geological rock cavity and erosion cavern carved out of hard Tux schist and limestone by glacial grinding and meltwater torrents over millennia. Encircled by ancient mixed mountain forests, moss-covered metamorphic boulders, and bubbling spring brooks, this tranquil retreat radiates a mystic serenity that draws nature enthusiasts seeking contemplative quiet.

Route & Requirements

Reaching the Walschensaal involves a scenic forest and mountain hike starting from Tux-Lanersbach or Vorderlanersbach. The signposted walking trail follows shaded forestry roads, rooted forest tracks, and gently climbing alpine meadows, conquering approximately 250 to 350 meters of elevation change with a walking time of 1.5 to 2 hours. The trail presents no severe technical difficulties but requires ordinary physical fitness, sure footing over wet roots and damp stones, and ankle-high walking shoes with non-slip soles. The natural forest trail is not suitable for strollers, yet children will enjoy discovering the storybook woodlands and rock crevices. Wooden bridges cross crystal-clear streams, and rustic resting benches offer sunny stops overlooking the Tuxer Hauptkamm peaks.

Visit & Arrival

As a designated natural monument, the Walschensaal is accessible free of charge year-round; the safest and most enjoyable season spans from May to late October. In winter, forest paths can become iced over, requiring spikes or snowshoes. Motorists travel via the A12 Inntal motorway (exit Zillertal), take the B169 to Mayrhofen, and follow the Tuxer Landesstraße up to Lanersbach (free hiking parking near the Eggalmbahn). By rail, take the Zillertalbahn to Mayrhofen, where the Tux regional bus departs every half hour to Lanersbach.

Tips

Combine your walk to the Walschensaal with a circular hike via rustic Schrofenalm or a stop at a traditional inn in Lanersbach. Pack a thermos of tea to savor the deep mountain silence and crisp air at this peaceful retreat.
dauer: 1.5 to 3 hours (walking time approx. 1.5 to 2 hours)
oeffnungszeiten: Accessible year-round free of charge (snow-free months May to October recommended)
